title: English Practice Quiz 0374
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: He wants to become ___ engineer.
questions.explanation: Engineer begins with a vowel sound, so use an.

questions.question: Someone says, 'Thank you for your help.' You reply:
questions.explanation: You're welcome is a natural response to thank you.

questions.question: You need to report a problem. You say:
options: There is an issue with the printer.
questions.explanation: There is an issue with... clearly introduces a problem.

questions.question: The bus is ___ than the car today.
questions.explanation: Use the comparative form faster when comparing two things.

questions.question: How ___ apples do you need?
questions.explanation: Apples are countable plural nouns, so use many.

questions.question: There ___ two chairs in the room.
questions.explanation: Use are with the plural noun chairs.

questions.question: A person who repairs water pipes is a ___.
questions.explanation: A plumber installs and repairs water pipes and fittings.

questions.question: We have a meeting ___ Monday.
questions.explanation: Use on with days and dates.

questions.question: A colleague asks for help. A polite reply is:
questions.explanation: Certainly. What do you need? is helpful and polite.
